versions.content: The name of the Application Header File of an AUTOSAR software component shall be Rte_[Byps_]<name>.h . <name> is the AUTOSAR software component type name. [Byps_] is an optional infix used when component wrapper method for bypass support is enabled for the related software component type (See chapter 4.9.2).
